final: WITH batting_hands AS (SELECT p.bats, SUM(cnt) as bats_total FROM (SELECT ma.player_id, p.bats, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.bats) t GROUP BY p.bats), overall AS (SELECT SUM(bats_total) as overall_total FROM batting_hands WHERE bats_total IS NOT NULL) SELECT bh.bats, bh.bats_total, CAST(bh.bats_total AS FLOAT) / o.overall_total as ratio FROM batting_hands bh CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY bh.bats
